It reflects the deep-rooted respect and value given to the mother figure in Hindu tradition. The name Ashima is also associated with the ancient Hindu goddess Ashima, who represents the eternal feminine power characterized by strength and motherly love.

historical_references.reference: Ashima was an important goddess in the Vedic era, believed to bring good fortune and prosperity. Her name is derived from the Sanskrit words 'ashe' (without) and 'ma' (sorrow), indicating her power to remove suffering and misfortune.
